$comment: Request/response JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) for open-terminal.postman_collection.json, rendered into its items' descriptions and OPEN_TERMINAL_SCHEMAS.md (linked from OPEN_TERMINAL.md). Edit here, then: uv run --no-sync python scripts/api_schemas.py render open-terminal. An OPEN subset (additionalProperties: true) of an upstream server, image open-terminal-zeo:0.13.0 (ai/open-terminal/Dockerfile.open-terminal on ghcr.io/open-webui/open-terminal:0.13.0, OPEN_TERMINAL_VERSION). Sources: the box's GET /openapi.json (info.version 0.13.0) lists only 16 paths (the rest carry include_in_schema=False upstream, and it declares no response bodies), so its request schemas are used for those (titles dropped) and everything else is read from open_terminal/main.py at the v0.13.0 tag and open_terminal/utils/*.py; each entry's `$comment` says which. Checked by unit-tests/apidocs only (tier 1); an image-tag bump re-checks them (ai/open-terminal/CLAUDE.md).

exec_result.$comment: execute() / get_status() in open_terminal/main.py; output from open_terminal/utils/log.py read_log

output.description: Output entries since `offset` (the last `tail` of them when `tail` is set)

type.description: `output` when the command runs on a PTY

truncated.description: Entries were skipped: rotated out of the log, or cut by `tail`

next_offset.description: Pass back as `offset` to read only new output

pty_session.$comment: an interactive PTY session (create_terminal in open_terminal/main.py)

pty_error.$comment: the PTY routes answer errors as `{"error"}`, not `{"detail"}`

description.description: From the SKILL.md frontmatter, at most 1024 chars

GET /openapi.json.$comment: FastAPI's generated document (app = FastAPI(...) in open_terminal/main.py at the v0.13.0 tag); checked against the box's GET /openapi.json (info.version 0.13.0); image open-terminal-zeo:0.13.0 (ai/open-terminal/Dockerfile.open-terminal on ghcr.io/open-webui/open-terminal:0.13.0, OPEN_TERMINAL_VERSION).
GET /openapi.json.description: No authentication (FastAPI serves it without the routes' API-key dependency). Lists only the routes without `include_in_schema=False` -- on the box 16 paths: `/info`, the file read / write / search tools, `/execute*` and `/api/terminals/user/*` -- which Open WebUI turns into the model's tools.

prompt.description: OS, kernel, architecture, host, user, shell and Python version, then OPEN_TERMINAL_INFO; or OPEN_TERMINAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT with its `{{...}}` variables filled

GET /files/read.description: The model's `read_file` tool. A text file, or a document whose text it extracts (PDF, Office, OpenDocument, …), answers JSON; a binary whose type starts with an OPEN_TERMINAL_BINARY_MIME_PREFIXES entry (`image` by default) answers its raw bytes with that type; any other binary is a 415.

POST /files/replace.description: The model's `replace_file_content` tool. 404 when the file is not there; 400 when a target is not found, or found more than once without `allow_multiple`.

path.description: Path to the file to modify.

end_line.description: Narrow the search to lines at or before this (1-indexed).

allow_multiple.description: If true, replaces all occurrences. If false, errors when multiple matches are found.

replacements.description: List of find-and-replace operations to apply sequentially.

What the text extraction leaves out
